a: This card's effect reads "when this card would be [...] digivolved into," therefore the effect doesn't activate for digivolutions from this card.
Card Q&A.q: If this Digimon has 3 or more digivolution cards and I have a Digimon with the [Night Claw]/[Light Fang]/[Galaxy] trait, is the digivolution cost still reduced by 2 when digivolving this Digimon into a Digimon card in my hand?

Effect: When this card would be played or digivolved into, if you have a Digimon with 3 or more digivolution cards and the [Night Claw], [Light Fang] or [Galaxy] trait, reduce the play or digivolution cost by 2.
[On Play][When Digivolving] Until the end of your opponent's turn, 1 of their Digimon can't suspend.
Notes: 2024 Championship Regionals Champion Card Set Wave 1
Special Digivolution Condition: [Digivolve] Lv.4 w/[Night Claw]/[Light Fang] trait: Cost 3
